name: progress-steps
summary: Shows ordered workflow progress with completed links and one current or error step.

agent.useWhen: A finite multi-step workflow needs visible completion, current state, and future work.
agent.avoidWhen: Progress is continuous, indeterminate, or only a page-level status.

invariants: Contains 2 to 10 items ordered complete*, exactly one current/error, then upcoming*.
Only completed steps have safe hrefs; every other state forbids href.
State labels default to Completed, Current, Needs attention, Upcoming and may be localized.
Optional icon rendering requires locked check/alert geometry. Native JSON hrefs accept whole named routes calls; the host checks route existence, argument types, codecs and emission provenance.
